assets.aiDesc: Imify uses ONNX Runtime Web to run lightweight AI models 100% locally. These models are downloaded once and cached for offline use, ensuring your data never leaves your device.

fonts.managementDesc: Install custom fonts to style the text printed beneath your QR codes. Google Fonts can be fetched directly, or you can import system-wide local fonts and OTF/TTF files which are converted inline to lightweight WOFF2 format.
